alt: The FCC confirmed receipt of a consumer complaint, assigned Ticket No. 8382473, and indicated that consumer submissions aid in enforcing the Communications Act.
summary: The FCC confirmed receipt of a consumer complaint, assigned Ticket No. 8382473, and indicated that consumer submissions aid in enforcing the Communications Act.
full_text: The FCC confirms receipt of your complaint, assigned Ticket No. 8382473. You will receive periodic updates as the complaint progresses. The email notes that consumer submissions help the FCC enforce compliance with the Communications Act. A link to the FCC FAQ page is included.
